Optuna run metadata by model

W&B cache exported at 2026-11-03T15:09:48.487670+00:00.

Objective statistics use measured runs lasting at least 300 seconds. Timing coverage also includes shorter measured runs. Variance is sample variance (ddof=1); singleton variance is unavailable. Objective units are tokens/s and milliseconds. Timings use seconds and variance seconds².

One objective observation is one eligible completed trial. Full trial histories and best/Pareto-only summaries remain separate. Model totals pool phases and concurrencies; contextual rows retain them. Differing workloads and search budgets can affect descriptive means. Both metrics of throughput/E2E Pareto studies are shown.

Constrained studies include only SLO-feasible objective results. Timing tables retain all recorded trial states.

Initiation is launch-to-ready, including model loading. Engine log loading and compilation observations can overlap; they are never added to wall time. Partial timings appear in trial rows and are excluded from means. Repeated log durations appear as lists. Missing telemetry is unavailable. Optuna PED-ANOVA importance is computed per run and objective from complete trials; conditional parameters absent from some trials do not enter the shared search space.
